recognize_zh: 這是低倍掃描視野，只看得到散在紅血球間的幾顆小而緻密的白血球核，看起來未明顯分葉；但解析度太低，無法可靠判斷核的分葉型態，需換高倍確認 Pelger-Huët 異常。
features: Very low-power view of a well-spread peripheral blood smear
Scattered leukocytes with compact, dense, apparently non-lobulated nuclei
Nuclear segmentation and granulation cannot be assessed at this magnification
Red cells evenly distributed without clumping
describe_en: Very low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows an evenly spread monolayer of red cells with a few scattered leukocytes. The leukocyte nuclei appear compact and dense, but nuclear lobation, chromatin pattern, and cytoplasmic granulation cannot be evaluated at this magnification. This field is useful for choosing an area for high-power review rather than for diagnosis. Findings are nonspecific; Pelger-Huët anomaly requires high-power demonstration of bilobed or non-segmented neutrophils with mature chromatin across the neutrophil population.

ddx.vs: Separation requires high-power review for hypogranularity and other dysplasia and clinical context, not assessable at scanning power.
At low power small lymphocytes and hyposegmented neutrophils both appear as round dense nuclei; high power shows the neutrophilic cytoplasmic granules.
